entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Bazaar Mosque, also known as the Memi Bey Mosque, is a Sunni mosque located in Gjirokastër, Albania. The mosque was designated as a Cultural Monument of Albania in 1973; and forms part of the Historic Centres of Berat and Gjirokastër, designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2005.
